Hallelujah! Praise the LORD from the heavens; praise Him in the highest places.
Give praise to the Lord. Let the Lord be praised from the heavens: give him praise in the skies.
你們要讚美耶和華！從天上讚美耶和華，在高處讚美他！
Praise Him, all His angels; praise Him, all His heavenly hosts.
Give praise to him, all you his angels: give praise to him, all his armies.
他的眾使者都要讚美他！他的諸軍都要讚美他！
Praise Him, O sun and moon; praise Him, all you shining stars.
Give praise to him, you sun and moon: give praise to him, all you stars of light.
日頭月亮，你們要讚美他！放光的星宿，你們都要讚美他！
Praise Him, O highest heavens, and you waters above the skies.
Give praise to him, you highest heavens, and you waters which are over the heavens.
天上的天和天上的水，你們都要讚美他！
Let them praise the name of the LORD, for He gave the command and they were created.
Let them give praise to the name of the Lord: for he gave the order, and they were made.
願這些都讚美耶和華的名！因他一吩咐便都造成。
He established them forever and ever; He issued a decree that will never pass away.
He has put them in their places for ever; he has given them their limits which may not be broken.
他將這些立定，直到永永遠遠；他定了命，不能廢去（或譯：越過）。
Praise the LORD from the earth, all great sea creatures and ocean depths,
Give praise to the Lord from the earth, you great sea-beasts, and deep places:
所有在地上的，大魚和一切深洋，
lightning and hail, snow and clouds, powerful wind fulfilling His word,
Fire and rain of ice, snow and mists; storm-wind, doing his word:
火與冰雹，雪和霧氣，成就他命的狂風，
mountains and all hills, fruit trees and all cedars,
Mountains and all hills; fruit-trees and all trees of the mountains:
大山和小山，結果的樹木和一切香柏樹，
wild animals and all cattle, crawling creatures and flying birds,
Beasts and all cattle; insects and winged birds:
野獸和一切牲畜，昆蟲和飛鳥，
kings of the earth and all peoples, princes and all rulers of the earth,
Kings of the earth, and all peoples; rulers and all judges of the earth:
世上的君王和萬民，首領和世上一切審判官，
young men and maidens, old and young together.
Young men and virgins; old men and children:
少年人和處女，老年人和孩童，都當讚美耶和華！
Let them praise the name of the LORD, for His name alone is exalted; His splendor is above the earth and the heavens.
Let them give glory to the name of the Lord: for his name only is to be praised: his kingdom is over the earth and the heaven.
願這些都讚美耶和華的名！因為獨有他的名被尊崇；他的榮耀在天地之上。
He has raised up a horn for His people, the praise of all His saints, of Israel, a people near to Him. Hallelujah!
He has put on high the horn of his people, for the praise of all his saints; even the children of Israel, a people which is near to him. Let the Lord be praised.
他將他百姓的角高舉，因此他（或譯：他使）一切聖民以色列人，就是與他相近的百姓，都讚美他！你們要讚美耶和華！
